name: Lakeshore Rail demo
description: Questions about the fictional demo documents in data/demo (seeded with COMPOSE_PROFILES=demo), and one off-topic question the input guardrail should block.

questions.question: Is there step-free access at Kestrel Bay station?
questions.expected: Yes: every Lakeshore Rail station, Kestrel Bay included, has step-free access to all platforms. Kestrel Bay is staffed from 06:00 to 20:00.

questions.question: Can I bring my dog on Lakeshore Rail trains?
questions.expected: Yes, up to two dogs or cats per passenger travel free. Dogs must be on a lead and animals may not occupy seats; assistance dogs do not count towards the limit.

questions.question: How much is an Off-Peak single from Port Avalon to Highfold?
Can I take a full-size bike on the train?
questions.expected: Yes, with a free bike reservation, limited to four bikes per train. Bikes are not carried on weekday trains arriving at Port Avalon between 07:00 and 09:30. Folding bikes travel free at any time.

questions.question: Do trains to Highfold run when it snows?
questions.expected: In heavy snow the Highfold branch may close; replacement buses then run between Merrow and Highfold, taking about 50 minutes instead of 25.

questions.question: Will strong wind delay trains to Kestrel Bay?
questions.expected: When forecast gusts exceed 70 km/h, trains between Port Avalon and Kestrel Bay run a reduced timetable at 50 km/h, adding about 15 minutes.
